an4.184:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho jāṇussoṇī brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodī.
an4.184:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho jāṇussoṇī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an4.184:2.1: ahaṃ hi bho gotama evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi :
an4.184:2.2: “natthi yo so maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati. na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassā”ti.
an4.184:2.3: atthi brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati, santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:2.4: atthi pana brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati, na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:3.1: katamo ca brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati, santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa?
an4.184:3.2: idha brāhmaṇa ekacco kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho.
an4.184:3.4: tassaññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti :
an4.184:3.5: piyā vata maṃ kāmā jahissanti, piye cāhaṃ kāme jahissāmīti.
an4.184:3.6: so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati. sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:3.7: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati, santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:4.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇa idhe kacco kāye avītarāgo hoti avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho.
an4.184:4.3: tassaññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti :
an4.184:4.4: piyo vata maṃ kāyo jahissati. piyaṃ cāhaṃ kāyaṃ jahissāmīti.
an4.184:4.5: so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:4.6: ayampi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati, santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:5.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇa idhekacco akatakalyāṇo hoti akatakusalo akatabhīruttāṇo. katapāpo kataluddo katakibbiso.
an4.184:5.3: tassaññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti :
an4.184:5.4: akataṃ vata me kalyāṇaṃ, akataṃ kusalaṃ, akataṃ bhīruttāṇaṃ,
an4.184:5.5: kataṃ pāpaṃ, kataṃ luddaṃ, kataṃ kibbisaṃ.
an4.184:5.6: yāvatā bho akatakalyāṇānaṃ akatakusalānaṃ akatabhīruttāṇānaṃ katapāpānaṃ kataluddānaṃ katakibbisānaṃ gati, taṃ gatiṃ pecca gacchāmīti.
an4.184:5.7: so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:5.8: ayampi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati, santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:6.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇa idhekacco kaṅkhī hoti vicikicchī aniṭṭhaṃgato saddhamme.
an4.184:6.3: tassaññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti :
an4.184:6.5: so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:6.6: ayampi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati, santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:6.7: ime kho brāhmaṇa cattāro maraṇadhammā samānā bhāyanti santāsaṃ āpajjanti maraṇassa.
an4.184:7.1: katamo ca brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati, na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa?
an4.184:7.2: idha brāhmaṇa ekacco kāmesu vītarāgo hoti vigatacchando vigatapemo vigatapipāso vigatapariḷāho vigatataṇho.
an4.184:7.4: tassaññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa na evaṃ hoti :
an4.184:7.5: piyā vata maṃ kāmā jahissanti, piye cāhaṃ kāme jahissāmīti.
an4.184:7.6: so na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:7.7: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:8.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇa idhekacco kāye vītarāgo hoti vigatacchando vigatapemo vigatapipāso vigatapariḷāho vigatataṇho.
an4.184:8.3: tassaññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa na evaṃ hoti :
an4.184:8.4: piyo vata maṃ kāyo jahissati, piyaṃ cāhaṃ kāyaṃ jahissāmīti.
an4.184:8.5: so na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:8.6: ayampi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati, na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:9.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇa idhekacco akatapāpo hoti akataluddo akatakibbiso. katakalyāṇo hoti katakusalo katabhīruttāṇo.
an4.184:9.3: tassaññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti :
an4.184:9.4: akataṃ vata me pāpaṃ, akataṃ luddaṃ, akataṃ kibbisaṃ,
an4.184:9.5: kataṃ kalyāṇaṃ, kataṃ kusalaṃ, kataṃ bhīruttāṇaṃ.
an4.184:9.6: yāvatā bho akatapāpānaṃ akataluddānaṃ akatakibbisānaṃ katakalyāṇānaṃ katakusalānaṃ katabhīruttāṇānaṃ gati taṃ gatiṃ pecca gacchāmīti.
an4.184:9.7: so na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:9.8: ayampi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:10.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇa idhekacco akaṅkhī hoti avecikicchī niṭṭhaṃ gato saddhamme.
an4.184:10.3: tassaññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti :
an4.184:10.5: so na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:10.6: ayampi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati, na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:10.7: ime kho brāhmaṇa cattāro maraṇadhammā samānā na bhāyanti, na santāsaṃ āpajjanti maraṇassāti.
an4.184:11.1: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama …pe… upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
